patches.expect: $5/vehicle/day or $30/year at the North Fork Skykomish Trailhead — Northwest Forest Pass, Interagency Recreation Pass, or the Forest Service's on-site digital 'Scan & Pay' all work; Washington's Discover Pass is NOT accepted here.
patches.value: None: the climb starts from an unmarked roadside pullout on FR-63, not a fee trailhead.
patches.fact: Where the approach starts: North Fork Skykomish Trailhead (end of FR-63) vs an unmarked river-crossing pullout near Galena (~Mile 10, ~1,150 ft)
